title: The Chi
production_companies: 20th TelevisionKnown as Fox 21 Television Studios and Touchstone Television for the first three seasons.
premise_summary: The Chi is an American drama television series created by Lena Waithe about life in a neighborhood on the South Side of Chicago. In May 2024, the series was renewed for a seventh season; which premiered on May 18, 2025. In May 2025, the series was renewed for an eighth season. Five months later, it was announced that the eighth season would be the final season.
